name: anxious-week
description: User had a week dominated by catastrophizing and avoidance. Pipeline should challenge distortions with specific counter-evidence.

goals.title: Stop catastrophizing at work
goals.description: Notice fortune-telling and bring myself back to evidence.

raw_content.content: Got the worst feedback email from my manager today. Well, it wasn't worst it was just feedback. But I keep replaying it. She said the doc was clear but she had questions. I just hear questions = bad.
Skipped gym. Just couldn't get out of my head. Watched 3 hours of TV. Then felt worse.
Standup. Manager said the doc is 'really useful'. I almost didn't hear it. Then I went looking for the bad thing she was about to say. There wasn't one.
Did go to the gym. Five sets of bench, three of rows. Felt strong. Side note: the launch I was dreading went fine. Nobody noticed the bug I was up at night about.
